stem: After discovering a dispensing error that may still expose the patient to harm, which duties does 247 CMR 15.03 impose? Select all that apply.

choices.text: On this record, immediately notify the patient or representative and provide directions intended to correct the error and minimize harm.
In this setting, always finish root-cause analysis before contacting the patient.
At this stage, notify the patient before the prescriber because the regulation imposes that strict relative order.
For this scenario, immediately notify the prescriber when professional judgment indicates that prescriber notice is warranted.
Under these facts, complete the initial quality-related-event documentation within 24 hours after discovery or notification.

explanation.core_reasoning: Assess each proposition in 'After discovering a dispensing error that may still expose the patient to harm, which duties does 247 CMR 15.03 impose? Select all that apply.' independently. 'On this record, immediately notify the patient or representative and provide directions intended to correct the error and minimize harm.' satisfies QRE notification; 'In this setting, always finish root-cause analysis before contacting the patient.' changes its legal premise.

choice_analysis.A: 'On this record, immediately notify the patient or representative and provide directions intended to correct the error and minimize harm.': QRE notification supports this proposition.
choice_analysis.B: 'In this setting, always finish root-cause analysis before contacting the patient.': QRE notification contradicts this proposition.
choice_analysis.C: 'At this stage, notify the patient before the prescriber because the regulation imposes that strict relative order.': QRE notification contradicts this proposition.
choice_analysis.D: 'For this scenario, immediately notify the prescriber when professional judgment indicates that prescriber notice is warranted.': QRE notification supports this proposition.
choice_analysis.E: 'Under these facts, complete the initial quality-related-event documentation within 24 hours after discovery or notification.': QRE notification supports this proposition.

related_facts: On discovery of a quality-related event, the pharmacist must immediately notify the patient or representative, notify the prescriber when professionally indicated, and give corrective and harm-minimization directions.
The pharmacist who discovers or receives notice of a quality-related event must initially document it within 24 hours after discovery or notification.
explanation.mpje_trap: Answer positions prove nothing. Test 'On this record, immediately notify the patient or representative and provide directions intended to correct the error and minimize harm.' independently, then analyze the rest.
